direct_host_interface.scope: Plain C++ declarations copied from exact frozen Parameters definitions for cudaLaunchKernel on retained CUDA host stubs. The new root launcher must independently enforce its admitted schedule and preserve caller-owned storage/counter/lifetime contracts.

shared_host_contract.storage: All arguments are exact-size contiguous rank-1 torch.uint8 physical byte buffers, including Half images and signed-int32 counters.
shared_host_contract.graph_and_module_lifetime: Caller retains physical inputs, records, mutable buffers and graph ownership through completion; recordStream is not a graph/module lifetime proof.

existing_fp8_composition.reset_positions: At each block start: contract/qkv/attention-completion/projection. Never reset the QKV predecessor between QKV and attention.

deployment_gaps: These are existing fixed B1 FP8 M2160 and independent Half M128 APIs; no arbitrary resolution, batch, empty or full-M Half admission is added.
Original plain attention is not the chained entry and is not silently mapped to it. This catalog lists chained attention only.
Half records are derived finite checkpoint data, not recovered original Half assets or original Half host preparation. Only block31 derived Half fixture hashes are bound here.

Standalone chained qualification serializes a fresh actual QKV producer. The preserved native >=0 relaxed poll does not itself prove final partition readiness or recover a concurrent native host schedule.
Original and CUDA split capacity must be queried on the actual compiled functions/device. Resource counts and previous occupancy observations are not unconditional deployment admission.

Donor object/binary hashes are inherited from accepted saved receipts, not freshly rehashed or relinked. Combining them into a new deployment requires its own source/object union and final identity gate.
